copy.curiosityHook: With dangerous creditors closing in on Worm's massive debts, Mike must risk everything he walked away from on the turn of a card.
copy.description: After losing his bankroll to gangster Teddy KGB, poker player Mike McDermott quits the game. But when his friend Worm is freed from prison buried in debt, Mike is pulled back to the underground tables to help him pay it off.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful neo-noir crime drama that balances thoughtful tactical play with gritty underground tension.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by John Dahl, this crime drama delivers calculated suspense as high-stakes card play collides with dangerous underworld debts and tested loyalties.

allowedMaterial: Mike McDermott's loss to Teddy KGB
